Ashiyana Heights

Condominium in Karon (near Kata)
HomeSaleAshiyana Heights

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

One seven-storey building with 131 apartments on a plot of about 1,760 sqm in the Karon sub-district, between Karon and Kata and about 1.4 km from Kata Beach. Studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom layouts are on sale, from around 29 sqm to 77 sqm.

The developer shows a rooftop sea-view pool and bar-restaurant, gym, sauna with ice bath, garden and lobby. Parking is provided for 34 cars and 18 motorcycles.

Completion is advertised for December 2028 on the main property portal; some sources give an earlier date, so confirm the schedule before reserving. Foreign buyers can hold freehold title within the 49% foreign quota.

Ashiyana Heights: key facts

  • Ashiyana Heights is a low-rise sea-view condominium in Karon, Phuket, developed by Ashiyana Estates.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 29.2–76.7 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Dec 2028.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,700,000.
  • Nearest beach: Kata Beach (1.4 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Kata Beach (1.4 km); Chalong Hospital (3.4 km, straight line); Dibuk Hospital (7.9 km, straight line); Makro (1.4 km, straight line).
